title: Wiki.js Sync folder config (.wikisync.json)
description: Maps the folder this file lives in to a Wiki.js path and controls which files sync. Drop it in (say) a project's docs/ folder.

url.description: Wiki.js base URL for this folder. Overrides the wikijsSync.url setting. e.g. http://localhost:3000

token.description: Wiki.js API token for this folder. Overrides SecretStorage / the wikijsSync.token setting. If you set this, add .wikisync.json to your .gitignore.

wikiPath.description: The Wiki.js path this folder maps to. A file at <thisFolder>/guide/intro.md becomes wiki page <wikiPath>/guide/intro. Omit or "" to map the folder to the wiki root.

assets.description: How non-.md files under this folder are treated. true (default): uploaded as Wiki.js assets, mirroring their path. false: ignored - only .md files sync.

include.description: Whitelist. Only files matching one of these gitignore-style globs sync. e.g. ["**/*.md"] to sync Markdown only. Mutually exclusive with the usual behavior - if set, everything not listed is skipped.

exclude.description: Ignorelist. Files matching one of these gitignore-style globs never sync. Replaces the wikijsSync.exclude setting for this folder.

metadataStorage.description: Where per-page sync metadata is kept for this folder. "frontmatter" (default): a --- YAML block at the top of each .md. "sidecar": a hidden sibling file .<name>.md.wikisync.yaml, leaving the .md as pure Markdown for publishing elsewhere. Overrides the wikijsSync.metadataStorage setting. Commit the sidecar files alongside the .md files.
